generation.commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One original square head-and-shoulders portrait icon for Pilot20 fantasy RPG species catalogue. Subject: [name_en] ([nom_fr]). Visual brief: [visual_guide]. Premium painterly fantasy concept art, midnight navy/graphite subdued background, warm copper/gold rim light, crisp silhouette readable at 64px. Center face and upper torso with 10% safe margin. Distinct species anatomy, generic adventurer clothing. No text, letters, logos, border or watermark. Do not copy any published D&D artwork. Keep consistent premium portrait framing across the series.
generation.koboldOverride: Small copper-orange wingless draconic humanoid, expressive red eyes, short rounded snout, subtle horns. Generic species portrait, no instruments or class costume. Same palette, framing and originality constraints.
generation.genasiOverride: Exactly one humanoid elemental person with bronze skin and ember-lit hair. One portrait, no quadrants or collage. Same palette, framing and originality constraints.
